title: Animal-Origin Ingredient Detected
subtitle: This product contains an ingredient of animal origin, or possible animal origin.
intro: BOTIA reads the ingredient list and flags ingredients that are confirmed or potentially derived from animals. It does not certify vegan or vegetarian status — it makes the label transparent.
direct_desc: Ingredient is always derived from animals. No ambiguity.
ambiguous_desc: Ingredient may come from animal or plant sources. The label does not specify. Only the manufacturer can confirm.

vegan_label_warning.title: About 'vegan' labels
vegan_label_warning.body: There is no legal definition of 'vegan' in EU, UK or US law. It is a dietary suitability claim, not a safety guarantee. A product labelled vegan may still contain animal-origin additives if the manufacturer has not verified the full supply chain.

cross_contamination_warning.title: About 'may contain traces of milk/egg'
cross_contamination_warning.body: This warning is for allergy protection — it does not indicate an intentionally added ingredient. Most vegan consumers do not consider cross-contamination warnings as invalidating vegan status.
